created: Account created. Give them a sign-in link, or their email and password.

mergeConfirm.details: Its occasions, time slots and organizations will be added to it, then this account will be deleted. Devices that used it will have to sign in again.

mergeDone: Merge complete: you are now viewing account #{{id}}.

occasionAddsOrg: An occasion also adds its organization.

signInLink.title: Sign-in link

removeFromOccasionConfirm: Remove from “{{title}}”? Their time slots in this occasion will be deleted.

cannotDelete: This account owns occasions or organizations: it cannot be deleted.
deleteHelp: Deletes the account, its time slots and its memberships.
